correctness.rationale: The star-product model follows from the original quandle multiplication. The truncated log coordinates are legitimate modulo x^p in characteristic p. Homogeneous degree decomposition reduces all derivations to shifts. Identities with 1 eliminate every negative and every nonresonant shift. The remaining recurrence produces exactly the differential operators H_j and multipliers E_j; direct Leibniz substitution proves sufficiency for arbitrary fields. Polynomial differentiation gives the complete commutator brackets and codimension-one derived algebra. An independent original-basis linear-system checker over twelve primes, including p=17,31,41,43, agrees with the dimension formula; operator and bracket checks span thirteen primes. Finite checks corroborate, not prove, the uniform theorem.

originality.rationale: Full same-object primary 2021 text supplies general constraints, characteristic-zero classification and modular n≤6 examples, not the universal characteristic-p basis/dimension/bracket theorem. A 2023 thesis reproduces that characteristic-zero analysis and develops distinct group-conjugation quandles. A 2023 Takasaki-ring paper works over R,C and studies modules. Earlier idempotent studies sharing logarithm and multiplicative-order parameter have different quantifiers/objects (elements satisfying f⋆f=f instead of Leibniz linear maps) and do not imply the Lie commutators. Searches in published mathematical records and targeted literature returned no direct covering claim; residual unindexed-literature risk remains.
residual_risks: An unindexed or later modular derivation computation under an alternative alias may already contain an equivalent formula.
The 2023 Takasaki-ring preprint was only abstract-inspected; its declared characteristic-zero scope makes direct coverage unlikely.
No independent specialist audit has yet tested the full proof.

value.rationale: The 2021 source explicitly left the positive-characteristic dihedral case at small tables. This is a complete structure theorem for an infinite family of nonassociative algebras, not a finite example or mechanical specialization. It gives an exact arithmetic dimension, the first jump at p=17, explicit derivation generators and every Lie commutator, an abelian ideal and a codimension-one derived algebra, enabling symmetry calculations beyond generic p²-variable linear algebra. The precise object and invariant are motivated by that published gap.
